title.en: A fat spy and a clever trick

text.en: Ausable is a secret agent who expects an important report. A gunman comes. Can Ausable outwit him?

Fowler, a young writer who loves romance, visits Ausable in a gloomy French hotel. Ausable is fat and does not look like a spy.
Ausable expects an important report at twelve-thirty and has a drink ordered for when he returns.
Another agent, Max, enters by the balcony with a gun and demands the report.
Max says he will wait with them for the thirty-one minutes until the appointment.
Max says he will take the report when it arrives and also reveals he has a pass key. Then a knock is heard, and Ausable says it must be the police, whom he had asked to check on him.
Max panics, says he will wait on the balcony, and climbs over the window sill with his gun still pointing at them.
Max drops and screams. The door opens and a waiter, Henry, brings the drink Ausable ordered. There were no police, and Ausable says there is no balcony.
The story shows presence of mind and courage. Quick thinking beats force.

problem.en: Ausable says the appointment is at twelve-thirty and Max arrives with 31 minutes left. At what time did Max arrive?

requiredIdeas.en: The waiter's knock is a coincidence he uses

points.en: Ausable is a fat, clever secret agent.
Max threatens him with a gun.
Ausable tricks Max with a balcony that does not exist.
The story shows presence of mind.
